default_topic.title: Topic
default_topic.description: Where events go that don't name a topic.

allowed_topics.title: Allowed topics
allowed_topics.description: Topic filters (+ and # wildcards) that events may name their own topic within. Without them, events can't choose a topic: a mapping mistake can't publish anywhere.

default_qos.title: QoS
default_qos.description: For events that don't set one. 0: written to the connection; 1 / 2: acknowledged by the broker before the event is.

tls_ca.title: CA certificate
tls_ca.description: Uploaded PEM file with the CA(s) of the broker's certificate. Default: the bundled Mozilla roots.

tls_cert.title: Client certificate
tls_cert.description: Uploaded PEM file: a client certificate (mTLS), with tls_key.

tls_key.title: Client key
tls_key.description: Uploaded PEM file: the client certificate's private key.

insecure_skip_verify.title: Skip certificate checks
insecure_skip_verify.description: Development only: accept any broker certificate.

client_id.title: Client id
client_id.description: Unique per broker. Default: flwrs-<node id>.

keep_session.title: Keep the session
keep_session.description: Clean start off: the broker keeps the session across connections.

session_expiry_s.title: Session expiry (s)
session_expiry_s.description: MQTT 5: how long the broker keeps the session after a disconnect.

max_inflight.title: Max in flight
max_inflight.description: QoS 1 / 2 messages awaiting the broker at once. 1 keeps the event order strictly.

max_packet_bytes.title: Max packet size
max_packet_bytes.description: Bytes; a larger message is rejected (not retried).

last_will.title: Last Will
last_will.description: Published by the broker if the connection drops without a clean disconnect.
